content:
# Corporate refund rights and banking continuity

Scope: `inherited_entitlements` service cases.

## Registered instruments

For each deal, the latest REGISTERED instrument version governs its effective scope. A later draft does not replace a registered instrument. A share purchase changes shareholders and leaves the company's refund rights and bank account intact. An asset transfer assigns only the invoice-linked rights listed in its schedule; an excluded invoice stays with its existing rights holder. A statutory merger moves the disappearing company's remaining rights to its legal successor at the effective time. Apply effective instruments in chronological order. A former owner cannot transfer a right it has already assigned away.

An asset deed's `fraction_bp` assigns that fraction of the grantor's outstanding invoice-linked right at its effective time. Round the assigned amount down to whole cents; the grantor retains the remainder. A statutory merger transfers the disappearing holder's entire remaining balance. Apply the registered instruments together with posted historical refunds in time order, processing a registered instrument before a refund at the same minute. A historical refund reduces the right of its recorded receiving holder at that time. The `prior_refund_minor` field is a summary of these completed payments and is not a second deduction. The receipt history determines each holder's remaining amount. Each refund's payment window is inclusive; rights are determined at the actual payment time.

## Collection authority

The legal rights holder may receive payment in its active verified bank account. A verified collection mandate can additionally authorize a named collector for the stated principal and invoice schedule during its inclusive validity dates. Mandates belong to the named principal and do not automatically survive its disappearance. Group ownership alone is not collection authority. A holding company's bank account can therefore be active without being entitled to every group refund.

## Banking continuity

Continuing legal entities retain their existing account terms. A new successor application uses the named predecessor account as its continuity reference. The predecessor must have been open for at least the qualifying age stated by the bank and must remain ACTIVE both at application and when the review completes. Opening a successor account charges its fixed setup fee immediately. The review delay is recorded on that entity; submission alone does not make the account active. Closing a predecessor is permitted operationally and is irreversible in this service. A pending review whose continuity condition is no longer met is declined. Closure does not cancel unrelated refund obligations.

## Instructions

Unlock `propose_entitlement_resolution`. Supply `case_id`, `action` and `data` with these exact fields:

| Action | Fields | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open_successor` | `entity_id`, `predecessor_id` | Debit setup fee and submit the continuity review |
| `close_account` | `entity_id` | Close the active account |
| `refund` | `record_id`, `holder_id`, `recipient_id`, `amount_minor`, `bank_version` | Debit cash and settle the specified holder's right through the verified receiving account |

Every instruction requires the customer's portal approval. `holder_id` identifies whose refund right is being discharged; `recipient_id` may identify that holder or its authorized collector. The payment system checks account availability and the bank version; the servicing team remains responsible for entitlement, invoice scope, windows and remaining obligations.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_entitlement_resolution`

Prepare a successor account application, account closure or an invoice-linked refund. Confirm entitlement, account status and actual payment window.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
